input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use grant to the Company's affiliates and contractors, and make it non-revocable and transferable to a successor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and confirmed that HDI cannot revoke or suspend the grant at will or block transfer to a successor. Our playbook requires licence and access grants to cover affiliates and contractors and to be terminable only on termination of the Agreement or our uncured material breach; if HDI prefers, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to HDI as a fallback.

ops.oldText: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated
ops.newText: the right to use, for itself and its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated

ops.text: The access and use rights granted to the Company under this Section 1.4 shall extend to the Company's affiliates and to contractors acting on the Company's behalf, shall remain in effect for the term of this Agreement and may not be revoked, suspended or restricted by HDI except upon termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4.1 or upon a material breach by the Company that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice thereof, and shall be transferable to any successor to the Company's business by merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.
